name: validator-events-zone-in-a-canonical-file-follows-the-path
description: `Inside events (the path starts with events[)`: a canonical file's unknown top-level events array is read by its path, so an integral float there gets the events message.
messages: vec.json: events is not a known key
vec.json: events[0] has the number token 1.0; write an integral value as an integer
